justifications.clinical.clinicalOutcomes: Vestibular training at any level improves clinical skill; AIB-specific certification outcomes not compared to other programs.
justifications.clinical.efficiency: Multi-level course series (VAM, VRII, VR, VRC); cumulative cost and time across levels.
justifications.clinical.caseloadApplicability: Applicable in vestibular and balance specialty settings; common referral from ENT.
justifications.clinical.reimbursement: Standard vestibular billing; no AIB certification billing premium over standard vestibular PT billing.
justifications.clinical.marketDemand: Moderate employer demand in vestibular specialty; AIB pathway is a recognized training route.
justifications.clinical.patientSatisfaction: Vestibular patients value any specialized expertise.
justifications.business.cashPayViability: Same insurance-dominated vestibular patient base; cash-pay is limited.
justifications.business.pricingLeverage: AIB is a recognizable brand but not premium-pricing-defining on its own.
justifications.business.marketDifferentiation: Differentiates from generic outpatient PT but less than full advanced/competency pathways.
justifications.business.ownerLeverage: Reasonable — accessible enough to train multiple staff and build a vestibular program.
justifications.business.marketDemand: Consumers don't search for AIB specifically; physicians may.
justifications.business.efficiency: More accessible cost/time than university-based advanced pathways.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyRecognition: Commercial CE branding; lower recognition than Emory/APTA pathways or NCS.
justifications.academicClinical.scholarship: AIB-affiliated faculty publish, but it isn't a scholarly credential per se.
justifications.academicClinical.teachingValue: Useful for vestibular lab content in DPT programs.
justifications.academicClinical.evidenceDepth: Underlying vestibular rehab evidence is strong; AIB content reflects it.
justifications.academicClinical.facultyDemand: Rarely listed by name in faculty postings.
